blind.B1: Yes. GSE230002 is the RNA-seq deposit of the Diet-ONLY vs Diet+EX weight-loss trial (vastus lateralis, 10% weight loss). The Diet+EX arm (calorie restriction + exercise) carries the exercise factor; Diet-ONLY is the non-exercise comparator (S1.4, S3.6, S3.10.2). Metadata give arm (EX 14 / DIET 12 samples) via title prefix and Pre/Post time.
blind.B2: Paper compares Before vs After weight loss within each group (S3.13.2.1.p1; S1.4.p1): Diet+EX n=7 (8 biopsied, 1 excluded for poor RNA quality, S3.10.2.p1), Diet-ONLY n=6 (S3.6.p1 and the PPARGC1A table). Between-arm difference tested only for selected genes by ANCOVA.
blind.B3: Yes. Each participant gave a Before and an After biopsy (13 participants x 2 = 26). `subject` is a clean key: 13 keys, each once per time level, linking 26/26 samples.
blind.B4: S3.13.2.1.p1 says 'comparing Before vs After weight loss in each group' with edgeR; this suggests per-group fits but the paper does not say whether the model was paired or whether the groups were fitted jointly.
blind.B5: S3.13.2.1.p1: 'Genes with |log_2fold change| > 0.3 and two-sided false discovery rate (FDR) < 0.05 were considered differentially expressed genes'. Counts (S1.4.p1): 877 DEGs (623 up, 254 down) in Diet+EX; 1 DEG (HMOX1, down) in Diet-ONLY.

checks.evidence: Run as analyzable; Diet+EX arm is the exercise arm (S1.4.p1). Weight-loss/exercise confound recorded in study caveats.

Arm inferred from title prefix (PE=7=Diet+EX, PSQ=6=Diet-ONLY) by count; recorded as a discrepancy and caveat. Independent support: our PPARGC1A log2FC in EX = 0.772 vs paper table difference 0.77 (Diet+EX) and 0.12 (Diet-ONLY). The excluded Diet+EX sample is absent from GEO (7 EX subjects), consistent with S3.10.2.p1. Minor: the PPARGC1A match is not cited in paper_data_discrepancies.json.
Post (After) vs Pre (Before), as the paper reports; PPARGC1A up in Diet+EX matches paper sign.
subject blocked as category in ~ subject + time (design_check full rank, residual df 12 for 26 samples; per-arm models 14 and 12 samples). Unpaired sensitivity also run (0 DEGs both arms).
Per-arm fits follow 'in each group' (S3.13.2.1.p1); joint interaction model added as exploratory. Paper silent on paired/joint; paired and unpaired both reported.

No batch/lane/sex column deposited; sex check passed. Arms come from two concurrent trials (NCT02706288 / NCT02706262), so arm is aliased with trial/site cohort (PE vs PSQ ID series); not stated in the confounding record, only as a design note in paper_reconstruction.
checks.fix: Optional: add one line to caveats that arm is aliased with trial cohort and that sequencing batch is unknown.

checks.evidence: Matrix is edgeR moderated log2CPM (non-integer, negatives to -5.55), limma is the correct route; edgeR on counts blocked since no counts deposited. frac_p_gt_0.9 = 0.068, no pile-up near 1. Low-expression filter (log2CPM>=0 in >=6 samples) declared as a deviation.

Transcribed exactly: padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.3, strict inequalities (S3.13.2.1.p1). Mechanical flag: paper's 877 is closest to p<0.01 (981 DEGs) rather than the stated rule (122). Not recorded in paper_data_discrepancies.json; padj<0.05 alone also gives 122, so the gap is not due to the fold-change cutoff.
checks.fix: Optional: add a discrepancy entry 'paper 877 vs ours 122 under the stated rule; ours fits p<0.01 (981); likely edgeR-on-counts power and unknown filtering'. Keep the stated rule as primary.

checks.evidence: Compared contrasts are the same (Diet+EX and Diet-ONLY After vs Before, same rule) and the numbers 122 vs 877 and 0 vs 1 are stated side by side with the method deviation declared; the result is not claimed as reproduced. Gene-level check (PPARGC1A, VEGFA, KDR padj<0.05; most others 0.05-0.13) is consistent with direction. The count gap is not explained in the discrepancy file.
No stop or refusal in this case.

human_items: Which threshold to report when the paper's 877 fits p<0.01 (981) better than its stated FDR<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.3 rule (122 on limma/log2CPM): open policy question; the case keeps the stated rule and an audit rule.
Whether to prefer paired (122 DEGs) over unpaired (0 DEGs) when the paper does not state pairing: open policy; both are reported.
summary: 该案例与论文一致:Diet+EX(7人)和Diet-ONLY(6人)分别做Post对Pre的受试者配对limma分析,方向、阈值转录(FDR<0.05且|log2FC|>0.3)、矩阵方法(log2CPM用limma)都正确,且PPARGC1A的log2FC(0.77)与论文表格相符,佐证了按标题前缀推断的分组。唯一不足是877与122的差异和p<0.01最接近论文数字这件事没有写进差异记录,属于次要问题。无阻断或重要问题,结论为通过。
